text:
Priya: Quick sync — Legal pushed back on BYOK dates for AcmeCorp. They need guaranteed 7y retention for audit logs + key escrow evidence for SOC2. Can we decide launch gates and whether Q3 is realistic? Asking about tradeoffs: search SLA vs cold-archive cost, and whether BYOK must be GA or pilot.

Marco: My take — split into phases. Phase 1 = Audit export + per-tenant TTL + basic search/indexing. Phase 2 = BYOK handshake + escrow API + rotation tests. Phase 1 looks doable in Q3, Phase 2 Q4 unless we greenlight an opt-in pilot. :thinking_face:

Lina: Security acceptance criteria we need before GA:
- Keystore handshake + rotation test (automated)
- Immutable audit proof (hash chain + signed digest)
- KMS access policy + recorded access events
- Threat model + pen test signoff for BYOK
We cannot ship BYOK GA without HSM/KMS integration docs and tests.

Eli: Ops constraints: 7y retention at Acme's ingest rate increases our storage commitment materially. Quick calc for their volume: ~3.2TB/year => ~22.4TB over 7y. Ballpark cost at Tier B = ~$3.2k/month. Also need export quota, RBAC, and restore runbook.

Priya: Proposed minimal launch gates (draft):
```
Gate A: Audit export + tenant-configurable TTL (min retention options)
Gate B: Immutable audit hashes + export API + search index for last 90d
Gate C: BYOK handshake + KMS access policy + rotation test (opt-in pilot allowed)
Gate D: Legal + SOC2 mapping signoff + ops runbook in runbooks central
```

Marco: Agree with gates. Suggest making Gate C opt-in for Q3 pilot (small cohort, manual escrow verification) and require Gates A/B/D for Q3 GA. That gets product out while buying time for HSM work.

Lina: Fine with C as opt-in if pilot is limited and HSM-backed keys only. Need a clear degradation path if pilot keys fail.

compliance-bot: Runbook stub created: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/byok-playbook — test IDs: BYOK-ROTATE-01, AUDIT-HASH-03, EXPORT-ACL-02

Priya: Next steps: Marco to produce a short tradeoffs doc + timeline by Tue EOD, Lina to draft the security acceptance criteria page, Eli to run a detailed cost calc and restore SLA, and I'll set a customer sync for Wed 15:00 PT. Please ack and add anything missing. @Marco @Lina @Eli

Marco: ack
Lina: ack
Eli: ack

Priya: Thanks — I'll DM legal to confirm exact SOC2 control language and invite Acme to pilot if we're aligned.
